verdict.rationale: The CRA is a government tax and registration agency, not a platform that hosts user-built automations, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence does not show the CRA shipping such a capability. EFILE transmission history and ReFILE amended returns are filing records and corrections, not automation version control or rollback, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
